title: Cairnsmore of Fleet Local Air Crashes
location_name: about 5 miles east of Newton Stewart, Stewartry
memorial_details:
Rough Hewn Stone with metal plaque which commemorates seven air crashes near here during WW2 and one other in 1979. One of the crashes was of a German aircraft.

The memorial is erected by NG 1 Staffel of Kampfgeschwader 4, indicating a strong connection to the local community and their defense efforts.
